summary: Implemented OncoReady's complete light-theme Treatment Readiness Golden Path (CORE-001). Built responsive React + TypeScript + Vite architecture with deterministic workflow engine, live Treatment Readiness Graph, multi-perspective views (Patient, Staff Triage, Navigator, Caregiver, System), and full caregiver privacy data-minimization projection.

tests.notes: Passed all 6 unit and DOM integration tests covering reset-to-confirmed workflow, dual-task routing, and caregiver clinical data minimization assertion. Production build generated zero type errors and zero warnings.

notes_for_next_agent: The hero journey runs entirely in browser memory with safe localStorage fallback and 1-click deterministic reset.
The signature Treatment Readiness Graph dynamically animates dependency links and updates nodes upon nurse/navigator/patient actions.
Caregiver privacy projection strictly filters out all patient clinical text and nurse triage notes.
Reduced-motion accessibility toggle and non-color semantic cues are fully implemented and verified.
Ready for feature integration and verification gate.
